name: Lunchtime NPC's
source:
Introducing Lunchtime NPCs! A visual novel about a protagonist with a severe lack of friends (how relatable). You start trying to make friends at your new school, when you come across a group of weirdos! You decide its your life's mission to get to the bottom of why these people are so weird, which leads you to wacky hijinks, a lot of crackers, and chaos you never thought could happen.

[from [url=https://toomanygalkie.itch.io/lunchtime-npcs]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
介绍一下《Lunchtime NPCs》！这是一部关于严重缺乏朋友的主人公的视觉小说（真让人有共鸣）。你开始尝试在新学校交朋友，却碰到一群怪人！你决定，把弄清他们为何这么古怪，当作自己的人生使命。于是，你陷入荒诞的闹剧，遇上大量薄脆饼干，以及做梦都想不到的混乱。

[摘自[url=https://toomanygalkie.itch.io/lunchtime-npcs]itch.io[/url]]
